definitions.explanation: A specific instance or occurrence of something happening. Used to count occurrences or refer to a particular instance.
When followed by に, indicates 'every time that ~' or 'whenever ~'. A very common grammatical pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{試|ため}して→試す：02130_tamesu⟧⟦みて→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧{度|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I remember every time I see it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦させたい→させたい：noentry⟧。
examples.english: I want to make it succeed this time for sure.
examples.notes: ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧ = this time, next time

examples.english: I feel energized every time I meet him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めなかった→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: I failed many times, but I didn't give up.
examples.notes: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ = many times

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧{度|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Every time I go to Japan, I find a new shop.

notes:
USAGE: This noun is extremely common in the pattern 〜{度|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ meaning 'every time that ~'. Do not confuse with ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧ (journey) which has the same reading.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{度|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (every time ~, whenever ~)
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (many times, repeatedly)
- ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧ (this time, next time)
- ⟦{毎度|まいど}→毎度：00266_maido⟧ (every time - often in business greetings)
- ⟦{度々|たびたび}→たびたび：00397_tabitabi⟧ (often, frequently)
- ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧ (once), ⟦{二度|にど}→二度：09503_nido⟧ (twice)

NOTE: {度|ど} is the on'yomi reading used with numbers (⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧, ⟦{二度|にど}→二度：09503_nido⟧, ⟦{三度|さんど}→三度：15154_sando⟧...), while {度|たび} is the kun'yomi used in the pattern 〜たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.
